about.appDescription: Smart Windows C: drive cleanup tool
about.portableUpdateHint: Portable builds do not install updates automatically. Download the new zip from the author's channel and replace the current folder; GitHub Releases is the official fallback.
about.updateHint: Updates are hosted on GitHub. DNS issues may affect access in some regions; retry later if needed.
about.nameDescription: Light means lightweight and C refers to the C: drive. LightC helps clean system junk safely and efficiently to free disk space.

logRetention.desc: Auto-delete oldest logs when count exceeds limit (1-100)
logRetention.title: Max cleanup logs to retain

dataDir.cannotWrite: Current storage location is not writable. Please extract the portable package to a directory with write permissions.
dataDir.migrationDone: Legacy AppData migrated. Original data remains.
dataDir.changeDirDesc: Select a dedicated empty folder for cleanup logs and cache data. Config file will not be migrated.
dataDir.viewLogsDesc: View historical cleanup records and detailed file lists
dataDir.clearDataDesc: Selectively clear logs, backups, snapshots, history cache and virtual disk records
dataDir.migrateSuccessDesc: Original AppData data retained. Portable version now uses the program directory.

systemTools.startupDesc: Open Task Manager to disable unnecessary startup programs
systemTools.storageDesc: Open Windows built-in disk cleanup and space management

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: If you encounter a problem or have a suggestion, contact me through one of the channels below.

clearData.title: Clear local data
clearData.subtitle: Only the allowlisted data below is removed; app settings are kept.
clearData.warning: These items can be cleared safely without removing app settings. Disk change snapshots are separated by drive, so you can keep a drive's baseline. A cleared drive will rebuild its baseline on the next scan and show comparisons again after the following scan.
clearData.summary: {{count}} files will be removed; estimated space freed: {{size}}

bigFiles.title: Large file cleanup
bigFiles.scanLimitDesc: Controls the maximum number of files returned per scan. Higher values find more candidates but increase rendering and review cost.
bigFiles.range: Range: {{min}} - {{max}} items. Switching drives clears old results so files from different drives are not mixed.

hotspot.title: Large folder analysis
hotspot.depthDesc: Number of folder levels shown in results
hotspot.minSizeDesc: Folders below this size are excluded to reduce noise.
hotspot.ignoreSystem: Skip system folders in deep scans
hotspot.ignoreSystemDesc: Turn this off to find unusually large files in protected folders, at the cost of a much longer scan.
hotspot.autoIgnoredDesc: The following folders are skipped or protected during scans and will not appear as cleanup candidates:

diskGrowth.title: Disk change analysis
diskGrowth.maxEntriesDesc: Limits the number of folders returned after comparing with the previous snapshot. Higher values increase rendering and sorting cost; 300 or fewer is recommended.
diskGrowth.range: Range: 50 - 1000 items. The baseline list still appears on the first scan or when there are no changes.
